# Disagreement Log — GTH_097

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 97
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 97 | "jar full of meal" | "jar filled with grain" | "jar of flour" | *pōfs*: meal vs. grain vs. flour |
| 2 | 97 | "the meal emptied out" | "the grain poured out" | "flour trickled out" | Loss verb: emptied vs. poured vs. trickled |
| 3 | 97 | "she had not noticed the problem" | "she had not noticed" | "she had no idea anything was wrong" | Obliviousness: simple vs. emphatic |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "meal" (appropriate for jar on a journey), "emptied out" (the result of the emptying, the most Thomas-like term), and "she had not noticed the problem" (slight elaboration but appropriate).
